about: Where each tracked file hangs on the dashboard's file map (scripts/pipeline/sources/spec_drift_files.py reads this on every build). A group hangs at one column: a station (s1 to s7) or a check between two (plan-auditor, spec-auditor, implementer, track-reviewer, ci, defect-rater). 'paths' places a folder or a file: a name ending in / is everything under that folder, and * stands for any run of characters inside one name. 'scripts' places a script of scripts/ by its name without .py; a script's own test (test_<name>.py) follows its script unless it is named here itself. The first group that fits takes the file. A file no group takes is drawn in the ring, 'on no station': add it here. One group may be marked 'loop': the improve loop's own files. It is no station, since it runs only when the maintainer asks, so the picture draws a dashed line from that group's column back to the column of every brief that has known cases; the build reads those briefs from specs/agent-cases/, not from here.

groups.label: plan.md
groups.what: The plan: the one text everything else is copied from.

groups.label: working rules
groups.what: The working rules every session reads, and the forms a spec is filled in from.

groups.label: agents
groups.what: Briefs of the AI reviewers that read the plan: the plan-auditor and the three end-of-phase auditors.

groups.label: day specs
groups.what: One Day's work, written down first: one file per Day.

groups.label: agent
groups.what: The spec-auditor's brief.

groups.label: scripts/
groups.what: Scripts that check the written text: plan links, wording, links, the index of behaviour.

groups.label: specs/plan
groups.what: The plan's commitments as data, and which promise serves which.

groups.label: specs/changes
groups.what: Short specs: promises made outside a Day.

groups.label: tests/
groups.what: The app's tests. Each must be seen failing before its code is written.

groups.label: scripts/
groups.what: Scripts that run the tests and prove a new one fails first.

groups.label: agent
groups.what: The implementer's brief: it writes the code and the tests of a track.

groups.label: agent
groups.what: The track-reviewer's brief: it reads each track's brief before the implementer starts, and its diff before the pull request.

groups.label: scripts/
groups.what: The script that checks a brief before it is sent.

groups.label: the driver
groups.what: The app itself: the driver's modules and run-steps.py, its entry point.

groups.label: hooks/
groups.what: The app's gates on a session: what a session may not do.

groups.label: rules/ docker/
groups.what: The app's rules for a session and its container image.

groups.label: scripts/
groups.what: Scripts that plant a bug on purpose and replay it.

groups.label: .github/
groups.what: CI's workflows and the pull request form.

groups.label: scripts/
groups.what: Scripts CI and the pre-push check run on a pull request.

groups.label: guards
groups.what: Guards on every working session in this repository, and the settings that wire them.

groups.label: specs/breaks
groups.what: The record of each Day's planted bugs, replayed after the close.

groups.label: notebook, trial
groups.what: The lab notebook and the trial's records.

groups.label: guides
groups.what: The README and the guides: what a reader is given.

groups.label: fixes
groups.what: The record of each fix: the pull request, and the defects it was made to stop. The two 'Does it learn?' graphs count from it.

groups.label: scripts/
groups.what: Scripts that replay a closed Day's evidence, print the close's views of its defects and relabel them.

groups.label: agent, cases
groups.what: The defect-rater's brief, and the known cases of every agent that has them.

groups.label: scripts/
groups.what: The script that asks an agent its known cases again, and the one that checks a pull request editing such an agent's brief shows the count.

groups.label: improve loop
groups.what: The improve loop, run only when the maintainer asks: the brief-improver drafts a better brief for an agent with known cases, and the script counts the draft on those cases before it reaches a pull request.

groups.label: settings
groups.what: Settings files. They serve every station and belong to none.

groups.label: re-check
groups.what: The script that tests finished promises again on later merges.

groups.label: dashboard
groups.what: The scripts that count the project and build this page.

groups.label: docs/dashboard
groups.what: The page itself: its markup, style, script and data files.

groups.label: agent
groups.what: The instrument-auditor's brief: it checks this page against git.
